findings.title: Synthetic playback switch records a 296 ms lab click duration
findings.conditions: synthetic fixture; playback active; 4× CPU slowdown; instrumentation off; three equivalent runs
findings.user_impact: The fixture records a 296 ms lab interaction; it does not establish a product budget violation, regression, or visible delay.
findings.caveats: This is a lab click duration, not field INP and not a current product result.

evidence.conditions: three synthetic equivalent runs; playback; 4× CPU slowdown

recommendation.direction: Use a real trace to split renderer, media, framework, and third-party work before choosing an implementation.
recommendation.retest: Repeat the same playback switch with normal CPU and 4× CPU slowdown, instrumentation off, after any authorized change.
recommendation.success_criterion: Meet a product-approved interaction budget with improvement larger than run-to-run variation and no media regression.
recommendation.stop_condition: Stop if a production-equivalent clean run does not reproduce the delay or the difference falls inside run-to-run variation.

findings.title: Offscreen mounted originals are a decode-pressure hypothesis
findings.conditions: synthetic 48-item Library DOM inventory; 14 cards visible
findings.user_impact: If the mounted originals are loaded and decoded, they may compete with scrolling and playback resources.
findings.caveats: Mounted is not loaded, decoded, or resident; the nominal RGBA8 proxy is not JS heap or GPU residency.

recommendation.direction: First verify loaded, decoded, and resident states plus interaction impact; only then consider card variants or windowing.
recommendation.retest: Measure the same list with resource metadata, decoded-state evidence, a fixed scroll, and playback negative control.
recommendation.success_criterion: Demonstrate less decode/resource pressure and a material interaction improvement without blank cards.
recommendation.stop_condition: Stop if offscreen resources are not decoded/resident or the interaction signal does not improve.

findings.title: The fixture contains repeated third-party requests
findings.user_impact: No user-visible performance impact is established by request count alone.
findings.caveats: Request count is not bandwidth, main-thread cost, privacy impact, or causal attribution.

recommendation.direction: Attribute transfer and main-thread work before changing tracker lifecycle.
recommendation.retest: Compare an equivalent product-approved tracker-on/off or isolated initiator trace.
recommendation.success_criterion: Show a reproducible user-facing or resource improvement without losing required analytics.
recommendation.stop_condition: Stop if the requests are cached/idle and have no material transfer, task, or interaction cost.

negative_findings.claim: The synthetic 10-cycle fixture does not show monotonic post-recovery DOM growth.
negative_findings.conditions: ten equivalent cycles plus fixed recovery
negative_findings.scope_limit: Does not cover a long editing session or media decoder resources.
